newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila to reward telecom firms for meeting targets.
newsitem.headline: Manila to reward telecom firms for meeting targets.

text.p: The Philippine National Telecommunications Commission said on Monday it will award permits for new telecom services to companies that meet their targets for installing new telephone lines.

"We will automatically disqualify those companies that are seeking permits for new services and instead give priority to players who are successful in meeting their roll-out targets as a reward," said NTC head Simeon Kintanar.
The Department of Transportation and Communication, Kintanar said, will issue a circular this month containing this reward provision.
Kintanar said that one such permit much sought by telecom firms is the authority to operate a personal communications system (PCS).

He added that 17 telecom companies have applied with the NTC seeking for authority to provide PCS services. These operate like mobile phones but can accommodate more subscribers because they use higher frequencies.
Under Philippine laws, a mobile phone operator is also required to install 400,000 fixed telephone lines within three years of the issuing of its cell phone permit.
Operators of international gateway facilities are required to install 300,000 lines within the same period.
